name: Finding the Source
summary: Krakle asks you to locate the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. He needs you to find the hottest spot.

sections.title: Among the Hot Spots
sections.body: At Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater, Krakle asks you to compare the area's hot spots. Check each one with the thermometer until you find the hottest.

faq.q: What does Krakle want me to find?
faq.answer: Krakle wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.

faq.q: Where am I looking for the hottest spot?
faq.answer: You are looking for it at Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: How do I check a hot spot?
faq.answer: Right click the thermometer at each hot spot to check its temperature.
